ud.demotion sits under the select in type.ui.caption, color.text.secondary (the kit's description style), as on board 01, after the T2 reason that now sits directly under the control (D09:49 (2a)).

Buttons, chips, badges, banners, fields, tiles, tables, menus and dialogs are compositions from tokens: admin controls are 32 px (size.control.comfortable, §4 L176) while the library CMP-001 binds size.control.height (24 px in the file's compact density), and cvsheet v1 cannot set an instance's glyph, fill or border.

T2 controls take the kit's t2_button() look (D09:49): color.surface.raised with a 1 px color.border.default hairline, the lock glyph and the full label in color.text.tertiary, the reason under the control in type.ui.caption color.text.secondary, one per control (§14 L608: 'each the control's aria-describedby'); the role and level selects and the grant checkboxes take the same look (local t2_select() and t2_box(); the kit has neither), a checkbox keeping its check (role=checkbox keeps aria-checked, D09:49).

A focus ring is a 2 px color.focus.ring inner stroke on a wrapper with space.inset.xs (4 px) padding, so it sits 2 px off the control (CMP-039) inside the wrapper's bounds; its radius is the next step (radius.card around radius.control); the wrapper adds 4 px on each side to the layout.

Grant rows (CMP-105 composition), as on board 01: the checkbox, the account and its env badge, the level select and the default profile's underlined link (navigation: enabled, §8 L405; DEV_LINK); here the checkbox and the select are T2 admin.locked with their reasons under them, so a row is taller than board 01's 32 px. The env badge follows the account name (unbind.lead's '{account} [{ENV}]', §14 L610); sub_002's environment is not in §1 (L99) or UD-2 (L385): a placeholder pill.

The profile links (CMP-021, two per frame) are underlined, as on board 01 (gen_01.py DEV_LINK): a drawn 1 px color.text.link rect under the text, as wide as the estimated text (cvsheet v1 texts take no textDecoration, and e42kit's link() draws none). They are the only enabled controls in the locked grant rows, and colour alone would not carry them: color.text.link is 1.18:1 against the tertiary T2 text beside it, 1.32:1 against the secondary reasons and 2.16:1 against primary text (dark #6EA1F5 vs #8B949E, #B1BAC4 and #E8EAED, token-sync), all under the 3:1 a colour-only link cue needs, and board 04 gets greyscale and deuteranopia renders (§0 L50-52, L72-73). The strip item, the board's other CMP-021 link, is a pill marked by its danger fill, its octagon and 'Unlock now', so the kit's 'colour + position only' link line is dropped from these notes.

The Danger zone's buttons follow the Tab order (§8 L405-406; §13 L585), as on board 01: Reset two-factor, Disable, Delete (§8 L361 lists 'Disable, Delete, Reset two-factor'); each is T2 admin.locked here (enabled, the kit's destructive look, D02:129).

The Save bar is a raised card (radius.card, space.inset.lg) at the page's end, not sticky (§8 names no sticky bar), as on board 01; here Save carries its description admin.locked under it, both flush with the bar's end.

TopBar, NavRail, RightRail and StatusBar content other than the Admin entry, the env badges and the owner's name is drawn as neutral placeholders (E10-D02 owns it; §1 L97 gives only the sizes); the chrome binds color.surface.app with color.border.subtle dividers (no source names a chrome surface).
